arguments.title: Beacon Plaza | Investment and Sales Offering Memorandum
arguments.subtitle: Charlotte, NC | Office | As of 2026-08-31

sections.heading: Executive summary
paragraphs: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

Beacon Plaza is a fictional office property evaluated using the attached certified rent roll (as of 2026-08-31), trailing-12 operating statement (2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31), insurance declaration, and limited lease records. The package provides sufficient detail to underwrite stabilized income and size senior debt under stated lender constraints.

Highlights: 12 suites totaling 64,860 SF across small/standard/large groups. Physical occupancy is 9 of 12 (pending not in possession), with 2 vacant and 1 pending. Stabilized underwritten EGI is based on scheduled rent at the certified roll with a 5% economic loss and $350 per suite annual other income. UW NOI before reserves: $1,042,534; UW NCF after reserves: $1,038,934. Capitalization value at 7.50%: $13.90MM. Sizing rate 6.75% (above 6.00% floor). Maximum loan is the LTV cap at approximately $8.34MM, implying net cash out about $1.71MM after costs and payoff.
No photos, market comps, sponsor information or asking price are provided or assumed.

rows: Sizing rate (greater of note vs floor)

sections.heading: Property overview and unit/suite mix
paragraphs: Property type: Office. Market: Charlotte, NC (fictional evaluation context).

Unit groups per manager mapping: A = Small suite, B = Standard suite, C = Large suite. Certified rent roll lists twelve suites: four of each A/B/C. Areas per suite type: Small 5,380 SF; Standard 5,500 SF; Large 5,710 SF.

sections.heading: Lease and occupancy analysis
paragraphs: As of 2026-08-31 certified roll: 9 active, 1 pending (not yet in possession), 2 vacant. Headline counts in the manager cover note included pending as leased (10 of 12), but certified occupancy excludes pending from physical occupancy.

Annual in-place rent from active suites: $1,214,100 (9 occupied × listed monthly base rents × 12). Suite 001 specifics confirmed by lease excerpt and manager correspondence: $11,050/month; expiration 2027-02-28; no free rent or amendments affecting rent as of the as-of date.
Near-term rollover: Suite 001 expiry is 2027-02-28, which is beyond 12 months from the as-of date; therefore, no near-term expirations are present.

sections.heading: Historical vs underwritten financials
paragraphs: Reported trailing-12 (cash basis) collections: $1,456,920; taxes $169,974; insurance $56,658; other recurring opex $226,632; roof replacement recorded as capital (no recurring repair component). Reported NOI: $1,003,656.

Underwriting per instructions uses scheduled rent for all suites from the current certified roll before the Suite 001 amendment, a 5% economic loss, and $350 per suite annual other income. Management fee at 3% of UW EGI. Replacement reserve $300 per suite/year. Taxes, insurance and other recurring opex per T12. NOI before reserves and NCF after reserves as stated in the executive summary.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and sources/uses
paragraphs: Constraints: Max LTV 60%; Min DSCR 1.25; Min Debt Yield 9%; 30-year amortization; note 6.75% vs 6.00% floor, size at 6.75%; 1% origination; $45,000 closing costs; existing payoff $6,500,000.
Loan sizing results: LTV cap $8.340MM; DSCR cap ≈ $10.679MM; Debt Yield cap ≈ $11.544MM; binding constraint is LTV. Maximum loan: $8.340MM. Net cash out after fees and payoff: approximately $1.712MM.

sections.heading: Risks and missing diligence
paragraphs: Pending-in-occupancy inclusion risk: Manager headline counts include pending as leased; certified occupancy excludes pending. We treat pending as not physically occupied for occupancy metrics.
Near-term rollover risk: absent (no expirations within 12 months).
Insurance documentation: present; limit $2,000,000 and active policy period. Insurance expense available via T12. No missing insurance risk.
Capital in opex risk: absent. Roof replacement is explicitly capital, not recurring opex.
Unsigned rent change risk: absent as of 2026-08-31 per correspondence; no amendments or concessions affecting Suite 001.
Temporary free rent risk: absent; none indicated in lease excerpt and correspondence.
Sizing floor binding risk: absent. The note rate 6.75% exceeds the 6.00% floor; the greater rate controls but floor is not binding.
Refinance shortfall risk: present if proceeds do not clear payoff and costs; here proceeds exceed payoff plus costs, yielding positive net cash out, so shortfall risk is absent.

sections.heading: Source notes
paragraphs: Manager cover note: mapping of unit groups A/B/C to Small/Standard/Large suites; manager headline counts include pending as leased.
Certified rent roll (2026-08-31): unit list, areas, statuses, monthly rents, expirations; Suite 001 at $11,050/mo and 5,380 SF; pending status note clarifies not yet in possession.
Operating statement T12: collections $1,456,920; expenses and reported NOI $1,003,656; roof replacement is capital.
Lease 001 excerpt and manager correspondence: confirms terms and absence of concessions or amendments as of date.
Insurance declaration: aggregate limit $2,000,000; dates July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.
